🎄✨THREE NIGHTS. ONE PARK. SO MUCH HOLIDAY CHEER!✨🎄

Christmas in the Park, presented by First Horizon Bank, is BACK December 18–20 from 6:00-9:00PM each night, and we’re turning Moncus Park into a holiday wonderland!

Gather your friends, bring the family, and get ready for a weekend filled with twinkling lights, live music, festive treats, and plenty of reasons to make a night of it. Best of all? Admission is FREE!

🎅 HERE’S WHAT’S WAITING FOR YOU:

✨ Twinkly lights throughout the Park
🎶 Live music all weekend long
🛍️ Merry Market, a Christmas market featuring local artisans
❄️ Sneauxville, with FREE ice sledding down the hill
🎁 Santa’s Workshop with crafts from the Children's Museum of Acadiana
💌 Letters to Santa
📸 Photos with Santa
🧱 Building Block Zone for creative little builders
🍫 S’mores, hot cocoa, mocktails, and holiday treats
🍴 Food Truck Alley featuring more than a dozen food trucks
🚂 Christmas Train rides
🎪 FREE fun jumps
🫧 Bubble Bus
🎄 Dedicated Sensory Zone


🎶 THE ENTERTAINMENT LINEUP

~ Friday, December 18: The Skyliners Big Band brings the swing with an 18-piece band!
~ Saturday, December 19: Corey Ledet & Black Magic take the stage with special guests Gracie Babineaux, Louie Michot, Mike Dopsie, and Nathan Williams.
~ Sunday, December 20: Enjoy a Christmas movie on the big screen with the Lafayette Shrimpettes and New Natives Brass Band roaming the park!


🚗 PARKING & SHUTTLE INFORMATION 🚎
Admission is free for everyone! On-site parking is $20, with proceeds supporting Moncus Park’s operations, maintenance, and gardens.

Prefer to skip the parking fee? Free parking and shuttle service will be available at Blackham Coliseum, located at 2330 Johnston Street. Shuttles begin at 5 PM each evening and are ADA-friendly.


📍 MONCUS PARK
2913 Johnston Street, Lafayette, LA 70503
📆 December 18, 19 & 20, 6:00-9:00PM each night


🎁 A FEW THINGS TO KNOW
• The event takes place rain or shine.
• Wear comfortable shoes and dress in layers for an evening outdoors.
• Leave pets at home so they can enjoy a quieter night while you enjoy the festivities.
• Please leave your ice chests at home & support our local vendors & beer tents.
• No tickets are required. Just bring your holiday spirit!

✨ Mark your calendars, invite your crew, and get ready for three nights of holiday fun at Moncus Park!


🎄 CHRISTMAS IN THE PARK IS MADE POSSIBLE BY OUR INCREDIBLE SPONSORS!🎄

A huge thank-you to our Presenting Sponsor, First Horizon Bank, and all the generous sponsors who help bring this holiday tradition to life for our community.

ERIK GRIFFIN is an American actor, comedian, writer, and director who can next be seen in Tony Gilroy’s BEHEMOTH! for Searchlight, opposite Pedro Pascal. He is best known for his work as the mustachioed “Montez Walker” on the hit Comedy Central series WORKAHOLICS, as well as for his series regular role in Showtime’s I’M DYING UP HERE, executive produced by Jim Carrey. Most recently, he was featured in TIFF 2025-premiering EASY’S WALTZ, opposite Vince Vaughn and Al Pacino. He also starred in THE EVERYTHING POT with Lisa Edelstein and James Wolk, which premiered at Tribeca in 2024. Griffin has additionally sharpened his skills behind the camera, having directed Matt Rife’s three wildly successful Netflix specials.
Prior to that, Griffin filmed the ABC pilot BUCKTOWN opposite Nicole Richie and the feature film MR. RUSSO, written and directed by Ray Romano. He was featured in the global Netflix film MURDER MYSTERY alongside Adam Sandler, as well as THE SLEEPOVER for Netflix, Laurie Collyer’s FURLOUGH, and the indie features GUEST HOUSE and MAYFIELD'S GAME. Griffin can also be seen in the box office hit MIKE & DAVE NEED WEDDING DATES.
A veteran stand-up headliner, Griffin performs in venues across the world, but most often can be seen at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles, CA. Griffin’s comedy is immortalized on his debut comedy album, TECHNICAL FOUL: VOLUME ONE, his Comedy Central special THE HALF HOUR, and his two hour-long comedy specials titled THE UGLY TRUTH and AMERIKAN WARRIOR, which are available to stream on Amazon and Showtime, respectively. You can also catch your weekly dose of Griffin on his hit podcast RIFFIN’ WITH GRIFFIN.

Brian Posehn has been busy for a while. As a writer/actor/stand-up comic, he doesn’t have a ton of downtime. He just recorded his fourth hour-long stand-up special. He’s currently co-creating and starring in an upcoming cartoon for Nickelodeon with Fall Out Boy’s Joe Trohman. Brian was an NSA intern on TruTV’s Top Secret Videos. You can also catch Brian on the popular Disney Plus show The Mandalorian, the acclaimed Netflix show Lady Dynamite, FX’s You’re The Worst, and in his recurring roles on The Big Bang Theory and New Girl. He was one of the stars of Comedy Central's popular show, The Sarah Silverman Program. He has also appeared on such seminal sitcoms as Seinfeld, NewsRadio, Everybody Loves Raymond, Friends, The Neighborhood, and a recurring role on Just Shoot Me.

In the sketch comedy world, he’s known as one of the writers and performers on HBO's acclaimed Mr. Show, in 2015 he co-produced Odenkirk and Cross’s return to sketch with the Netflix hit, With Bob and David. He was featured in the films Devil’s Rejects and The Five-Year Engagement. In 2015, he starred in the dark, indie comedy Uncle Nick.
In stand-up comedy, he’s known as one of the original members of the Comedians of Comedy. He’s released two half-hour specials for Comedy Central, four comedy albums, and three hour-long specials--The Fartist, Criminally Posehn, and 25 X 2.

In voice acting, he’s done everything from Scooby Doo to a recent role on The Simpsons. He starred on the animated shows Mission Hill and 3 South and has turned up in Adventure Time, American Dad, Bob’s Burgers, and Steven Universe, to name a few. His voice was featured in the 2017 DreamWorks animated comedy, Captain Underpants.

In the last several years, he’s also been able to produce and host a popular D&D comedy podcast, Nerd Poker, and co-write 45 issues of the best-selling Marvel comic book series Deadpool. In 2018, he released his first book, Forever Nerdy. In 2019, he completed a comedy metal album, Grandpa Metal, featuring metal legends from Anthrax, Dethklok, Slayer and Soundgarden.

Grandpa Metal was released to rave reviews in the metal world in February of 2020. In May, he was featured on Celebrity Worst Cooks on Food Network. He currently has a weekly two-hour show spinning his favorite metal songs on GimmeMetal.com. In 2021, he plans to compete on American Ninja Warrior, Top Chef, and So You Think You Can Dance. After he breaks TMZ and the Internet, when footage of him beating up a narwhal surfaces, he plans to quit showbiz.

Maria Bamford is revered for her deeply personal and experimental comedy about mental illness. She’s the author of the New York Times bestselling memoir Sure, I’ll Join Your Cult and is the star of four hour-long standup specials (Local Act, Weakness is the Brand, Old Baby and Maria Bamford: the special, special, special!) and the surreal, semi-autobiographical Netflix comedy series Lady Dynamite, about a comedian who suffers a nervous breakdown. Maria was the first female comic to have two half-hour Comedy Central Presents specials and starred alongside Patton Oswalt, Zach Galifianakis and Brian Posehn in The Comedians of Comedy. She also created and starred in the cult hit web series The Maria Bamford Show, in which she plays all the characters.
Maria is often recognized for her prolific voiceover work, including characters on Big Mouth and its spinoff Human Resources, HouseBroken, Teenage Euthanasia,

About this Event

Safe Sitter is a medically-accurate course to help young teens aged 11 and up feel more confident in their ability to care for younger children. Topics covered include infant and child CPR, caring for a choking infant or child, injury prevention and management, behavior management, safety for the sitter, child care essentials and more. This class can even help young teens feel more comfortable staying home alone.

All information is medically accurate and is taught by trained Safe Sitter instructors. During the course, students get hands-on practice in basic lifesaving techniques so they are prepared to act in a crisis. Also, each student receives a manual filled with great information and resources for the course and on the job, a Safe Sitter backpack, important numbers Post-Is pads, a Band-Aid dispenser and flashlight. The class will be held at the Foundation for Wellness Classroom, 126 Heymann Blvd Lafayette, La 70503, from 9 am-3:30 pm.

In order to comply with Safe Sitter Inc guidlines, only 24 students will be allowed to register and participate. We will not accept any students past our limit.


Students are required to bring their own lunch. Parents will be required to present a copy of the child's birth certificate, or proof of age to enter class and a completed registration form that will be sent out via email, the Friday before class.

https://happeningnext.com/event/the-amer._full:
For teachers of 6–12 grade
America’s 250th anniversary is an ideal time to reflect on and explore the American Creed, what economist Gunnar Myrdal refers to as “ (what) Americans of all national origins, classes, regions, creeds, and colors, have . . . in common: a social ethos, a political creed.” Since 2018, students around the country have been discussing American Creed videos (streaming on PBS LearningMedia) in class, with curricular support from the National Writing Project. Students have also been invited to create and share their own stories and reflections in photos, captions and/or essays via KQED’s national Youth Media Challenge publishing platform. This workshop supports adding Louisiana voices, which have been largely missing, to this nationwide initiative. Let’s get Acadiana students published!
Two National Writing Project Teacher Consultants, Lafayette Parish School System middle school teachers who have recently incorporated these exercises with their students, and the American Creed in Louisiana project lead, will guide middle and high school teachers through using photopoetry, a combination of art and literature that expresses feelings and emotions through both words and images. Participants will learn to guide students to create their own photopoems that capture the limitless potential and challenges of our American Creed.
No prior poetry or photography experience is required to participate. Bring your pens and phones and immerse yourself in easily adaptable exercises that can immediately be incorporated into classrooms to engage students in exploring these important foundational ideas of our nation in creative ways.
ABOUT THE PRESENTERS
Toby Daspit is Professor of Education and Emeritus Consultant with the National Writing Project of Acadiana at the University of Louisiana at Lafayette. He is the Project Lead for American Creed in Louisiana, funded by the National Writing Project. Toby has nearly four decades of experience as a middle, high school, and university educator. He is the founder of the Improving the Blank Page Youth Writing Program and is a featured poet for the 2026 Festival of Words.
Emily Weber is a middle school English Language Arts teacher at Edgar Martin Middle School in Lafayette Parish. She is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Educational Leadership at the University of Louisiana Monroe. Emily’s classroom is built around the belief that every student has a story worth telling. She has a particular passion for creative writing and strives to help students discover that writing is not just an academic skill but a powerful way to communicate, reflect, and connect with the world around them. Emily is a National Writing Project Teacher Consultant.
Kerrie Skerrett teaches gifted 6th grade English Language Arts at Edgar Martin Middle School and is entering her 14th year as an educator, with experience teaching in both general education and gifted settings. She is a graduate of both ULL and ULM. Kerrie, a National Writing Project Teacher Consultant, is involved in the American Creed Project because she is passionate about giving students opportunities to engage in authentic writing and make meaningful connections to the world around them.

https://happeningnext.com/event/the-grin._full:
Christmas Table Runner Cake Class
Create a showstopping Christmas centerpiece as you transform a long, elegant cake into a festive work of art featuring intricate vintage Lambeth piping in rich holiday colors.
What You'll Create
Each student will create one long, rectangular table runner-style cake, inspired by the trendy extra-long cakes designed to run beautifully down the center of a table.
We'll work with sheet cakes that are cut, stacked, and assembled to create the distinctive long, narrow shape of this style of cake. Students will then cover and decorate their cakes with beautiful vintage-inspired Lambeth piping, creating layers of swags, borders, shells, ruffles, and other decorative details.
To make your cake your own, each student may select up to two accent colors, in addition to the white base color, allowing you to create a Christmas color palette that fits your personal style.
Additional festive finishing details may be incorporated into the final design to complete the look.
What You'll Learn
This class combines cake construction with plenty of hands-on piping practice. Students will learn:
How to work with sheet cakes to create a long, rectangular table runner-style cake
How to properly cut, fill, stack, and assemble the cake
How to choose and use the proper cake board and support for a longer, more uniquely shaped cake
Tips for handling, decorating, and transporting an unusually long cake
How to work with a variety of piping tips
How to create classic vintage Lambeth-style piping
How to pipe swags, shells, borders, ruffles, and other decorative details
How to layer different piping techniques to create a cohesive vintage design
How to balance colors and piping placement across a long cake
How to customize your finished cake using your selected color palette
How to add festive finishing details for an elegant Christmas presentation
Choose Your Colors
Each student may choose up to two accent colors, which will be paired with the white base color of the cake.
Whether you prefer traditional Christmas red and emerald green, something softer and more elegant, or a completely different combination, you'll have the opportunity to customize your cake to your own style.
What's Included
All cake, buttercream, decorating materials, cake boards, and supplies needed during class are provided.
Each student will leave with their completed Christmas Table Runner Cake to take home.
Students may bring a drink, snack, and apron if they choose.
Please note: The classroom can get cold. A light jacket is recommended.

Art education is just as imp as math or science. It improves critical thinking, encourages innovation, and strengthens your connection with the community.

My name is Palak Dhorajiya, and I am obsessed with creating imaginative art. Growing up in India, I always had a passion for art. At the time, I would make time within my busy schedule as a full-time student to attend workshops and art classes.

https://happeningnext.com/event/yin-yoga._full:
Slow down, settle into the moment, and discover the power of stillness.
Yin Yoga is a slow, meditative practice that invites you to hold gentle poses for several minutes, allowing you to gradually work into the body's deeper connective tissues. Rather than flowing from pose to pose, you'll be encouraged to breathe, observe, and explore your own edge with patience and mindfulness.
As you remain in each posture, you'll have the opportunity to notice areas of tension, practice staying present through mild discomfort, and cultivate greater flexibility, self-awareness, and inner calm. Throughout class, your instructor will offer gentle guidance to help quiet the mind and support your experience.
The practice concludes with an immersive sound bath during Savasana, the final resting pose. Crystal singing bowls, Tibetan singing bowls, gongs, and other therapeutic sound instruments create a rich landscape of resonant tones that encourage deep relaxation and a peaceful transition into rest.
Whether you're looking to improve mobility, reduce stress, or simply carve out time to reconnect with yourself, this class offers a space to slow down, breathe deeply, and leave feeling refreshed and restored.
No prior yoga experience is necessary. All bodies and experience levels are welcome.
